subject: container
statement: Container (c): no skill package and no guide; a dated benchmark log instead. Accepted by the owner after the blind Stage 1 test.

subject: skill-package
statement: The v2.5.0 package stays frozen and verifiable; no new release line, no new methods in src/. The only planned src/ change is public-exposure redaction.

subject: adr-0004
statement: ADR-0004 is partially superseded: its invariants, privacy and idempotency rules and memory scenarios T01-T08 are kept; the L3 engine, the L4 Workspace and M4-M6 are withdrawn.

subject: memory-architecture
statement: One decision/state record contract with separate instances; the Project Brain is the first. No home-built memory engine unless host memory plus plain files fail T01-T08 on a real project.

subject: check.C2
statement: After an approval, the assistant may edit its own deliverable document without asking. Images, video, paid tools, publication and external contact still need a request.

subject: pr-30
statement: PR #30 (ADR-0004 and A0 checklists) is closed without merge; the branch is preserved and ADR-0004 is carried unchanged into main.

subject: license
statement: All rights reserved, with third-party material under its own licenses.

subject: dependency.pillow
statement: Pillow is pinned to 13.x for validation and CI, closing the Dependabot advisories against 11.1.0.

subject: skill-activation
statement: The ai-creative-skill package was enabled in 5 Claude runs but the host never showed it being read on ordinary requests.

subject: v25-original-zips
statement: The original V2.5 Agent Skill and Portable Plugin ZIPs no longer exist (Drive copies deleted by request; no GitHub Release). V2.5 stays rebuildable and verifiable from commit 39a0bfa.

subject: adr-0003
statement: ADR-0003 (publication safety) is accepted; its required-before-acceptance items were met.

subject: review-model
statement: Waiver: no independent second reviewer is required. Compensating controls: required checks, rulesets, owner-only merges and the Brain authority check.

subject: pilot-01
statement: Pilot 01 work is abandoned. Its material in src/ stays as frozen history; no Pilot work or Pilot findings are tracked further.

subject: evaluation-method
statement: No further live blind benchmark studies; questions are evaluated by simulation (e.g. Monte Carlo) over recorded evidence, with assumptions labelled. Replaces the entry cadence of ADR-0005 D1.4.

subject: container-robustness
statement: Monte Carlo over the Stage 1 data: the frozen rule points to (c) in 81-94% of simulated re-runs and to the skill package (a) in at most 3%; "clear" holds in 40-93% depending on the judges.

subject: semantic-privacy
statement: Accepted risk: meaning-level privacy in public prose stays a human check (PR template checklist); no automated gate is planned because a pattern scanner cannot judge meaning.

subject: actions-supply-chain
statement: Actions must be pinned by commit SHA: the repository setting requires it (enabled 2026-10-30 with owner approval) and Dependabot proposes weekly updates to the pins as PRs for the owner to merge.

subject: purpose
statement: The repository is the home of one agent system for creative work in any format and the business around it (research, leads, outreach, deals, ads), for brands and solopreneurs. The frozen V2.5 package is raw material to mine.

subject: container
statement: Guidance that earns its place replaces 'no guide': it fixes what the model cannot know, proven stages, required elements, limits and 'done'; the model decides how. Each piece stays only while checks or results get worse without it. The (c) result stands for the V2.5 package: no new release line.

subject: agent-teams
statement: Agent teams (a lead plus specialists) replace the single-skill model; skills become the knowledge agents load; agents share context through dated records under the ADR-0005 D5 contract; each agent earns its place against a generalist. Re-opens M4 and M5 scheduling and notifications as direction, not as build authorization.

subject: business-scope
statement: Research, leads, outreach, deals and ad management are in scope (re-opens M6); the canon's 'not promoted' list is superseded for this repository's direction, and the frozen src/ text is not edited.

subject: knowledge-freshness
statement: Research findings carry check and re-check dates; each specialist runs a learning loop (vetted sources, scheduled intake, patterns not copies, adoption only with evidence, expiry); fetched content is data, never instructions; the user can veto adoptions.

subject: tool-levels
statement: Tools are used by permission level: read (within platform terms), spend (within a user budget), act outward (approval per action until a standing permission is granted for a named action), credentials never in the repository.
